intervention: Original tangent projection, Gram-Schmidt, norm-preserving exponential map at last token. Replay the fixed single-anchor block-2 output at all positions before the native suffix, preserving causal masks and hybrid model state handling.
primary_response: FP32 L2 to the clean single-anchor reference, as in original sweep code.
secondary_response: FP32 L2 to a clean reference with the same suffix input and batch size; exact zero-angle parity required. A numerical check, not an outcome-based replacement metric.
threshold: For each model/pair/reference mode, 0.5 times the smaller maximum of the two axis curves on the median surface; original exact-sine fitter.
analysis: All planned attempts, p and fit residual, per-anchor and shared-anchor bootstrap, released-data comparison on 1.7B, same-pair cross-model comparison, reference-mode sensitivity, .5/1/2 threshold sensitivity.
stopping_rule: Six full 30-anchor 31x31 surfaces, subject to overlap exclusions; no pair or layer rescue based on new exponents, no lens readouts, no extra sweep expansion. Numerical correctness failures are repaired before continuing.
